sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: Anxiety will keep your nerves swollen for most part of the day, feels Ganesha. On the work front, you will face success later in the day. You will be a role model for business efficiency and people will try to follow in your footsteps. Your efforts will be validated with generous profits.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: A small gathering may take place in your neighborhood today if at all possible, Taurus. If you're currently involved, you will probably attend it with your significant other. If you aren't seeing anyone, you will run into some old friends and possibly make some new ones. Relax, let loose, and have a little fun.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: The Pisces Moon and Mars form an unbalanced aspect this morning, dearest Taurus, creating a thick and emotionally charged atmosphere. A psychic charge will cause you to drift in and out of the collective consciousness, and the energy you encounter won't always be enjoyable. If you begin to sense thoughts or emotions that don't feel like your own, call in your protection and return them to the sender. You'll have an easier time connecting with others without psychic repercussions when Luna and Mercury enter a harmonious trine this evening.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: A reunion with an old friend will brighten up your spirits. Monetary transactions will continuously take place throughout the day, and after the end of the day, you will be able to save enough. Your ability to impress others will bring rewards. You have the ability to achieve lots- so go after the opportunities that come your way. Understand the value of your time. It is useless to remain among people who are difficult to understand. Doing so will just give birth to more troubles. Today, your better half will support you in the most critical thing of your life.

readings.text: Your involvement in developmental activities at the workplace will be appreciated. You might have to check deadlines as some administrative work too will keep you occupied. You may come to the conclusion too easily. Ganesha says you should think pros and cons before making an important decision.

Pressure has been building and now you can no longer contain yourself. This feels like the day when a major confrontation will lead to a shift in the dynamics of your work. Trust that this shift will be for the best. Be prepared for whatever comes.

bits.t: On the work front, you will face success later in the day.
You will be a role model for business efficiency and people will try to follow in your footsteps.

readings.text: It’s all about your career progress today, which is directly linked with your finances. You will not be depending on other people’s money. Instead, you will be depending on your own efforts.

You would probably prefer not to have to worry about money, especially this week. But since it's a necessary part of life, you prefer to worry about broader things - that which you can't control. At this time, your money life is more ideas than reality, thanks to aspects happening in the area of your chart associated with past lives, institutions, the unconscious mind, and dreams. Your efforts to make any serious changes to your money situation now may need more time to develop.

Ganesha predicts that decision making may get difficult. As a result you might feel low and over stressed today. There are chances of conflict with a family member. Hence it is advisable to have patience and wait for a better day.

What if the thing you wanted most were given to you - would you know what to do with it? Think about what that would mean. What would you want? A new job? A new house? All these things are material and thus prone to change and disappointment. If you have your health you have something that is immaterial and thus more precious. Use the favorable aspect of the day to focus on what you really want. (Hint: focus on your health!)

bits.t: A psychic charge will cause you to drift in and out of the collective consciousness, and the energy you encounter won't always be enjoyable.

lucky.remedy: Toss a Copper coin in running water to make love life better.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: Have confidence in your ability to be a calming influence in touchy situations.
